note: Largest campground in the Smith River NRA (Six Rivers NF), 2.5 miles east of Gasquet on US-199, on a shaded flat about 50 ft above the Middle Fork Smith River, with paved spurs and huckleberry between sites. No river views from the sites; a three-minute trail leads down to the Panther Flat Picnic Area with river access and swimming holes. Showers are coin-operated. --Claude
